messages:
alex_support: FYI - customer 'AcmePay' opened an escalation: they got repeated 429s on POST /v1/chat even though the project quota tile shows ~520k tokens available. Happened around 02:05 UTC. Request IDs: req_8a1f, req_8a2b, req_8a5c. Attaching short repro below.

alex_support: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXXXX' -d '{\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"test\"}]}' 

alex_support: customer says their org-level usage on the invoice preview shows lower usage than the realtime dashboard. They think the enforcement is using a different counter. Can someone validate pipeline boundaries? :thinking_face:

tara_billing: thanks Alex. do we have the invoice snapshot id for that org? also want to know if this org has multiple projects sharing a token pool.

alex_support: invoice_snapshot: inv_2026-03-02-02, org: acmepay-org, project: acmepay-prod. They DO have two projects under same org, both using same API key historically.

dan_engineer: pinging infra — enforcement path uses the real-time token ledger (events stream -> rolling window aggregator) while dashboard uses the daily rollups from billing ingestion. If there's a lag or duplicate events in the realtime pipeline, you can see a mismatch + early throttles.

sam_ops: I pulled the stream around that time. ingest_bot shows a burst of token events for acmepay-org at 02:06:07. Could be duplicate events from the retry path.

ingest_bot: detected duplicate-event-batch for shard-7, sequence 551234 -> de-dupe window flagged.

sam_ops: attaching short extract: 
```
{ "org": "acmepay-org", "project": "acmepay-prod", "tokens": 124500, "ts": 1836204367 }
{ "org": "acmepay-org", "project": "acmepay-stage", "tokens": 124500, "ts": 1836204368 }
{ "org": "acmepay-org", "project": "acmepay-prod", "tokens": 124500, "ts": 1836204369 }
```

sam_ops: looks like the same user batch got replayed across two project ids in the real-time pipeline, doubling the sliding-window sum.

dan_engineer: that would explain 429s despite dashboard showing capacity. dashboard daily rollup likely collapsed duplicates during nightly billing consolidation; realtime aggregator did not de-dupe in the rolling-window path.

maria_sre: can we confirm if rolling-window aggregator has de-dupe logic enabled per shard? quick check: /infra/rolling-agg/config shows 'dedupe_on_ingest=false' for shard-7 (h/t).

dan_engineer: aha. I can push a hotfix to enable dedupe_on_ingest for rolling-agg + backfill to recompute the last 30m window. But that will take ~45m and we need mitigation now.

tara_billing: customer needs immediate relief — can we temporarily lift the project's enforcement or increase quota to avoid user-facing 429s while we fix pipeline?

maria_sre: temporary mitigation: add project-level override to bypass throttles for acmepay-prod for 1 hour. I'll do that and log it (INC-4821).

alex_support: please add a short note for the customer that we're investigating root cause and applied a temporary bypass, ETA ~1h. They'll appreciate transparency. :thumbsup:

dan_engineer: plan: 1) enable dedupe_on_ingest on shard-7 rolling-agg (hotfix) 2) run a recompute for 02:00-03:00 sliding window to remove duplicates 3) add a short-term enforcement override (done) 4) add alert to detect replay bursts in future. Filing BUG-9273 to add dedupe to realtime path.

sam_ops: quick query you can run to see the discrepancy: 
```
# approximate realtime sliding-window sum (last 5m)
curl -s "https://int-query.redwood/v1/ledger_sum?org=acmepay-org&window=300" | jq .tokens

# dashboard daily rollup for yesterday
curl -s "https://billing.redwood/v1/daily_rollup?org=acmepay-org&date=2026-03-01" | jq .tokens
```

ratebot: noticed correlated deploy at 02:05 by infra-deploy-bot -> commit c3f2b9 that touched ingest retry logic. Correlation score 0.82.

dan_engineer: adding that to investigation. might be an unintended side-effect of the retry dedupe change.

maria_sre: after enabling override and alerting customer, monitoring looks stable. no further 429s in last 12m. I'll coordinate postmortem and add a short blameless writeup.

alex_support: thanks all. I'll reply to the customer with the mitigation + ETA for full fix. Please add any relevant notes to INC-4821 and BUG-9273.

tara_billing: follow-up items for billing: confirm the nightly consolidation reconciles duplicates (it usually does). if not, we need a reconciliation job to align realtime enforcement with billing ledger.

dan_engineer: agreed. will add reconciliation job to backlog (ENGINF-1298).
